definitions.ratio: per donor: mean over its acceptors of Delta(u at q) / e, e = u_donor(p) - median interior u_donor (same model); median over donors
definitions.ci: similarity-unit (donor unit) bootstrap of the median, B=1000, seed 20261115 (same as x3_subwindow.boot_median definition)
definitions.paired_difference: per donor ratio(model or window A) - ratio(B); median and unit-bootstrap CI
definitions.donors: archived Part III donors/acceptors (RiboPipe CAN s123 peaks); not re-selected for any model (limitation for RiboMIMO-adapt)
definitions.RM_scale: RiboMIMO-adapt u = log1p(yhat); e computed with RiboMIMO-adapt's own u at the same donor peak
